thread:
alex: Quick sync — need to lock v2.15 rollout windows for US / EU / APAC. I sketched cutoffs that balance on-call hours and traffic. Can we confirm?

maria: Thanks — sharing the schedule helps. Can we push the APAC canary later by 2 hours to avoid region peak?

kevin: +1 on moving APAC. Also reminder: branch freeze for release/x.v2.15 should be enforced 6h before the US cutoff. Pls add to PR template.

emily: I updated the changelog draft in the repo (PR #482). Would like a quick review on the feature bullets — nothing blocking for release but want phrasing consistent.

alex: @maria good catch. Proposed change: APAC canary start = APAC local 02:00 (UTC+8) instead of 00:00. That makes it 18:00 UTC previous day.

sanjay: Are we comfortable with the fallback policy? If EU fails canary, do we fall back to last-stable model or cross-region serve from US? Need explicit ops runbook link.

kevin: Ops runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/release-fallbacks (added to release checklist). Fallback order: 1) last-stable EU pool, 2) US read-only pool w/ region-aware routing, 3) emergency rollback.

alex: Here's the proposed UTC timeline (compact):

```
- US canary start: 2026-05-14T02:00:00Z  (cutoff for branch freeze: 2026-05-13T20:00:00Z)
- US canary monitor: +30m, full rollout: +2h
- EU canary start: 2026-05-14T08:00:00Z  (prefers morning traffic dip)
- APAC canary start: 2026-05-13T18:00:00Z  (APAC local 02:00 on 2026-05-14)
- Final global complete target: 2026-05-14T12:00:00Z
```

maria: That looks reasonable. Can we add a brief note in the deploy channel 24h before + 2h reminder? I can handle the 2h ping.

emily: I'll finish changelog and tag maintainers for review by EOD tomorrow. @kevin can you nudge SDK owners about the minor version bump? We need their tests green before branch freeze.

kevin: Yep — will ping SDK owners in #devex and request CI green gates. Also adding a small lint job to the release CI to catch header/version mismatches.

sanjay: Oncall check: who is primary for EU canary monitor window? @alex?

alex: I'll be primary for US/EU canaries. @maria you ok to lead APAC warmup + rollback if needed?

maria: Happy to take APAC lead. I'll coordinate with APAC infra on warm cache preloads.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder queued: add "freeze-window" label to any PRs touching runtime/ serving. (automated) :robot_face:

kevin: Small ask — add a changelog header snippet to the PR template, something like: `Release: v2.15 — component: short description (owner)`. Saves copy edits.

emily: Done. PR template updated and linked in the changelog PR.

alex: Final checklist before we call this locked:
- [ ] Branch freeze time posted in channel 24h prior
- [ ] SDK owners notified and CI gates passing
- [ ] Changelog finalized and PR merged
- [ ] Runbook + fallback order pinned in release checklist
- [ ] Oncall rota set for canaries

maria: I'll create the channel reminder for the 24h and 2h pings.

kevin: I'll enable the lint job and confirm SDK CI.

emily: I'll merge changelog once wording is reviewed.

sanjay: I'll update the oncall rota and add a short oncall playbook note for the new fallback order.

alex: Great. Unless anyone objects, locking windows as above. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
